mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the small and large vessels was most worthwhile because it showed the whole route back to the blood and why it helps prevent fluid buildup.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the larger vessels to the vein felt fairly predictable from their matching outlines, though the valve panels added useful information.

surprise.text: I learned that the fluid is called lymph when it enters the lymph vessels; the separate blood vessel remains intact.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt arbitrary: each connected a visible part of the return route.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter. Building the complete route helped explain a body process I had not thought much about, although the pairings were straightforward.
